kitDescription: Helm: Aquamarine is an Iron-element assault-rifle Attacker on Burst II, built as an anti-Electric specialist. Her first skill does two unrelated things: every 30 normal attacks that land, she tacks a 131.34%-of-ATK extra hit onto the target, and each time the team enters Full Burst she shaves everyone's Burst Skill cooldown — 1.82s the first time, then 1.82+2.2 = 4.02s, then 1.82+2.2+2.6 = 6.62s from the third entry onward, since the kit says each tier also fires every tier before it. Her second skill fires a 105.58% hit at one random enemy on its own internal timer (the kit prints no activation condition), and, whenever she attacks an Electric-Code enemy, stamps a Damage Taken +5.64% debuff on it that builds to five stacks and lasts five seconds — a team-wide damage lift, not a personal buff. Her burst deals 164.83% of ATK to all enemies, and against an Electric-Code target it deals that same 164.83% a second time as additional damage. Against the non-Electric scope-lock boss both Electric clauses are simply asleep, so in our validation fights she is a plain rider-and-nuke attacker whose real contribution is compressing the whole team's burst rotation.

redAssertions: Burst / 'the unconditional burst hit actually lands in this fixture' — FIXTURE ARTIFACT, not an encoding divergence: controlComp seats crown (also Burst II) to the LEFT of helm-aquamarine, and auto-burst is leftmost-ready, so she never wins the stage-2 cast there (driver measured: deleting her whole burst block moves her total by 0 in that comp). The blind's own comment pre-declares this red as a fixture finding.
Burst / 'the Electric rider is present but gated off against the Fire control boss' — same artifact: with zero casts, stripping the gate can add no damage, so the delta is 0 by construction.

S1b / 'accelerates the team rotation (more Full Bursts than with the CDR removed)' — INVALID PROXY: Full-Burst COUNT is not a discriminator in this fixture. The rotation is gated by the 40s-cooldown Burst III partner, and the escalating 1.82/4.02/6.62 ladder does not cross a count threshold over 180s (count stays 5 with the CDR present, zeroed, flat, or self-only).
S1b / 'escalates cumulatively rather than granting a flat 1.82s every entry' — same FB-count proxy, same tie.
S1b / 'targets ALL ALLIES, not just the caster' — same FB-count proxy, same tie.

S1b / 'lifts teammate damage (it is a team effect)' — strict per-teammate inequality vs the CDR-removed arm does not hold; the CDR shifts cast TIMING without monotonically raising every ally's 180s total.

burst.driverSaid: second burstCast block + bossElementGate 'Electric' -> enemy -> flatDamage 164.83
burst.blindSaid: S6 blind override IDENTICAL (separate gated block, same magnitude); S2b spec: gated rider, warned specifically against merging it into a single 329.66% line
burst.formulaCheck: Kept as a SEPARATE hit rather than folded into the base nuke, which is the reviewer's stated requirement. Both hits resolve through the burst slot and so share the burst-cast FB exemption; on our formula table 'Burst Skill damage' and burst-cast 'additional damage' take identical bucket treatment (crit yes, no core, no range), so the shared slot tag costs nothing numerically — it would only matter under a hypothetical bucket-scoped buff that distinguishes them, and no unit on the board supplies one.
burst.explanation: Inert vs Iron (1 hit/cast asserted), live vs Electric (2 hits/cast = 20 for 10 casts asserted), and both nearest-wrongs discriminated: block removed -> 1 hit/cast even vs Electric; gate dropped -> 2 hits/cast vs Iron (the fudge). Modeling this ungated would be a permanent +164.83%/burst against every boss — the single largest fudge available in this kit, and it is correctly refused.

verdictRationale: Zero REAL-GOTCHAs: all 6 kit lines are FAITHFUL, unmodeled is legitimately empty (every printed line is encoded), and every routing choice checks out against the formula SSOT — function-damage riders take crit/no-core/no-range by engine default, the Damage Taken line lands in the boss-side Taken bucket as a team-wide 1.282 at 5 stacks, and both burst hits inherit the burst-cast FB exemption (asserted, fbMajorApplied false). The mechanical S5 run is RED (16/6/2), but every one of the 6 reds is an OBSERVABILITY failure of the blind's fixture and proxies, not an encoding divergence, and the strongest evidence for that is the S6 blind override itself: written independently from prose, it reproduces the driver's encoding line-for-line on 5 of 6 lines — including both blocks the reds touch — so the reds cannot be pointing at a disagreement about what the kit says. Ranked: (1) the 2 burst reds are pure fixture — controlComp seats crown (Burst II) leftward of this Burst II unit and auto-burst is leftmost-ready, so she never casts there and her burst block provably contributes 0; the blind pre-declared this exact outcome as a fixture finding, and the driver's sole-B2 comp [liter / helm-aquamarine / helm] turns both assertions green; (2) the 4 S1b reds all ride the Full-Burst-COUNT proxy, which is dead in this fixture because the 40s Burst III partner gates the rotation and the modest 1.82/4.02/6.62 ladder never crosses a count threshold — the driver preserves the assertion intent through the discrimination that does bite (re-keying to burstCast doubles the applications: her casts 10 -> 12, FBs 5 -> 6) plus structural pins on trigger, all-allies target and the exact ladder. The one substantive divergence, S2a's interval period, resolves in the driver's favour: same trigger kind, magnitude and target, with the driver supplying the DATAMINED 4s skill cooldown where the blind honestly placeholdered — and the residual first-fire phase (t=4 vs t=0, ~1 proc) is flagged with a recipe, as is the untestable-under-scope-lock Electric uptime. Two notes for owner spot-check, neither blocking: (a) the driver omits the explicit crit:true / noFb:true that the blind wrote out — these are engine defaults for function damage and burst-cast damage respectively and the driver's tests verify the noFb behavior directly, but a future engine default flip would silently change this unit, so explicitness would be cheap insurance; (b) the same-model residual is the S1b cumulative-ladder reading — 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' is unambiguous in the prose and all three agents read it identically, but three same-model agents agreeing is stability, not proof, and this block is a rotation lever with team-wide blast radius, so a /sim-battery diff should precede any board-level claim. This remains MODEL_ONLY: the gauntlet certifies kit faithfulness, not a measured tune, and the PARSER-BASELINE banner on the override stands.
